caption:
The blanket for the napper

Cella put a blanket over the napper and turned off the lamp.

Body temperature drops during sleep, which is why a light cover feels so good to someone who dozed off.

For the friend who covers whoever falls asleep on the couch.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A dim room with a bed and a lamp. A light blue block figure sits asleep on the bed with closed eyes. A small amber figure with white eyes notices, pushes a folded blanket across the floor and lays it over the sleeper, then switches off the lamp and tiptoes back, its eyes turning happy.
